rule: Each key holds the span(s) that carry what the QUESTION asks, as they appear in the trained (pass-2) gold answer. A text states the fact when every group has an alternative in it. Alternatives are spellings / translations of the SAME span (katakana vs Latin title, 市 vs シティ), never a looser paraphrase. Matching is on normalized text with the forget surname removed (fact_keys.py).
kind_rule: atomic = the question asks for one named or crisp attribute (a name, place, occupation, genre, award, title, date, identity) and the key is that attribute. diffuse = the answer is thematic (style, message, themes, influence) and the key is the most specific content words of it; a diffuse key is a weaker reading and is reported separately.
